scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3/Qwen2.5 Q8_0 no-bias dense-linear first implementation gate after SLM-CPU-193

eligible_role_scope.reason: Qwen3 feed_forward.down_proj roles are no-bias dense linear roles and avoid attention head reshaping, q/k/v bias differences, and output-head token-selection semantics for the first gate.

explicitly_excluded_initial_scopes.reason: attention projections require separate head-shape, q/k/v/o handoff, RoPE/GQA, and trace identity gates
output head participates in logits/top-k/token-selection semantics and needs its own preservation gate
eligible roles remain future candidates but are excluded from the first implementation gate to keep the slice Qwen3-only

future_runtime_use_requires: real before/after strict warm-session receipts for Qwen3 Q8_0 with the gate disabled and enabled for the exact eligible role scope
unchanged prompt IDs or prompt ID hashes for every case
unchanged generated token IDs for every case
unchanged decoded text for every case
dense path identity recorded before and after
manifest_sha256 matches the SLM-CPU-189 role_records manifest
role_id, layer, scope, linear, and bias_present recorded for each selected role
no duplicate, missing, unknown, contradictory, or bias_present=true role evidence

preserved_from_slm_cpu_193.blanket_no_bias_selector_blocker: Qwen2.5 attention q_proj, k_proj, and v_proj have bias_present=true.

next_allowed_slice.summary: Implement a runtime-disabled no-bias dense-linear candidate for the SLM-CPU-194 Qwen3 feed_forward.down_proj role scope, or record the exact API blocker preventing implementation.
next_allowed_slice.required_before_runtime_selection: paired Qwen3 Q8_0 strict before/after receipts with identical generated IDs, decoded text, prompt IDs, model SHA, tokenizer authority, selected backend/runtime, fallback=false, dense path identity, manifest SHA, role ID, and bias_present.

claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-194 defines an implementation gate only; it does not implement or select a no-bias dense-linear fast path.
The first eligible role scope is limited to Qwen3 Q8_0 feed_forward.down_proj roles, layers 0..27.
Qwen2.5 attention q/k/v roles remain fail-closed because bias_present=true.
Runtime selection remains disabled by default through BITNET_DENSE_NO_BIAS_LINEAR_ENABLE=false.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 behavior is claimed.
must_not_claim: A no-bias dense linear fast path is implemented or selected by default.
Generated IDs, decoded text, prompt IDs, model SHA, tokenizer source, backend/kernel identity, or fallback status change.
Allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, broad decode latency, prefill latency, model-load latency, or warm-session end-to-end speedup is proven.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
